coverage_type: Structured frame sampling over entire timeline with detailed selected intervals; not continuous or second-by-second viewing.
main_scene_identity: Retro wooden passenger carriage, with seating and aisle areas
limitations: Unseen gaps remain; short scene/camera changes within gaps cannot be excluded.
Total carriage bay count not verified; at least five suggested visibly, six remains reconstruction estimate.
No verified empty cabin or reverse-end view.
Only public 360p video and two public comments were available without sign-in.
